name: io.github.tonyyang0504/baijiahao-mcp
description: Baijiahao (social): me, read_comments, delete, analytics_post. Every tool maps to a documented endpo

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_BAIJIAHAO_APP_ID
environmentVariables.description: 作者帐号ID (app_id) shown when you enable 开发者 service in the 百家号 creator console (开通开发者服务，获取app_token及app_id).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_BAIJIAHAO_APP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: 授权密钥 (app_token) from the same 开发者 settings; sent in the request body of every call. Reset it at once if it leaks.
